title: Follow up qa-v1-theory-6fbc75c62863e94836ce0fc5
behavioral_concerns: follow up: durableOperationManager.AcceptOperation deduplication is bypassed when confirmation digest is empty, breaking idempotency for conflict case

evidence.summary: durableOperationManager.AcceptOperation guards deduplication on non-empty digest: `if err != nil && digest != "" && errors.Is(err, runcontrol.ErrConflict)` then ResolveOperationAlias, else generic persist error
beginDurableCLICommand passes empty digest to AcceptOperation, disabling dedup for that path

web operationHub startConfirmed in-memory dedup also gated on dedupKey != "" and forwards dedupKey (possibly empty) to durable AcceptOperation; TUI correctly computes sha256 hex digest but web/CLI can be empty

SQLite Accept only inserts operation_aliases when OperationAlias != "" and returns ErrConflict only on alias collision; empty digest path is therefore inconsistent with expected idempotent conflict handling
Existing test TestDurableOperationDeduplicatesAcrossManagersAndFailsClosed covers non-empty digest dedup only; no coverage for empty-digest conflict idempotency

theories.claim: durableOperationManager.AcceptOperation deduplication is bypassed when confirmation digest is empty, breaking idempotency for conflict case
theories.basis: durable_operations.go:106 gates conflict->Existing resolution on `digest != ""`; beginDurableCLICommand at line 55 passes empty digest; web operationHub startConfirmed also allows empty dedupKey
theories.verification_surface: read-only source inspection of durable_operations.go, web/operations.go, tui/app.go and runcontrol/sqlite.go without execution
theories.confirmation_condition: source shows `if err != nil && digest != "" && errors.Is(err, runcontrol.ErrConflict)` and a caller passes empty digest where ErrConflict could otherwise be resolved via ResolveOperationAlias to return Existing=true
theories.refutation_condition: source shows empty digest either never produces ErrConflict (no alias insert) or an alternative deduplication path handles empty digest idempotently
theories.inconclusive_condition: cannot determine repository conflict semantics for empty alias without runtime execution or schema constraint evidence

theories.outcome_reason: Verified durable_operations.go:106 includes `digest != ""` in conflict dedup branch, so any ErrConflict with empty digest falls through to `persist confirmed operation acceptance: %w` instead of ResolveOperationAlias->Existing. Caller at durable_operations.go:55 explicitly passes "" (CLI path) and web/operations.go:147 start() passes "" via hub, confirming the bypass path is reachable.
